result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed; one notable inconsistency found in the favorite/heart icon styling between two cards in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white background/outline, while the heart icon on the pizza card below it has a dark/black background, creating inconsistent visual styling between similar elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button style (background color, opacity) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
